verdict.rationale: A banking platform could plausibly offer AI-generated insights, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack shows no AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the product. Detailed card reports, automated reconciliation and the BoletoHolmes receivables investigator are standard features, not documented AI insight capabilities, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
